node.title: Re: In praise for a better community -- Vere papa mortuus est
node.author: harangzsolt33
node.doctext: I didn't know that when a perlmonk closes his account or deletes his/her account, then all of the posts made by that person are deleted automatically. That's kind of a bad design. The posts should not go away! The user should have the ability to remove them BEFORE he deletes his account. But if he doesn't, then the posts should stay.
